title: Can I BEAT Martin with 0% Damage?
summary: 'No damage run': Tony must beat Martin without losing ANY material — losing a single pawn or piece means losing the game. He plays prickly, develops the queen early, waits for Martin to blunder, and wins with ladder mate taking 0% damage.
rules: If the player loses any material (any capture of a player piece, including pawns, even in an equal trade) the player immediately loses.
Bot may capture freely; player wins by checkmate.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin without ever having a piece captured.

opponent.name: Martin
opponent.avatar_description: cartoon Martin, black beard, brown turtleneck

board.theme_notes: standard; thumbnail shows '0% Damage?' with 0% in red

events: Instant loss when any player piece is captured
current_impl_issues: Impl nocap forbids the PLAYER from capturing; the video rule is the opposite: the player may capture freely but loses instantly if the bot captures ANY player piece (0% damage).
